entries.title: Una mudanza empieza antes del camión
entries.intro: ¿Te cambias de casa? Busca contactos de fletes y mudanzas con ConectaProIA. Para consultar, indica tu comuna de origen, destino y fecha estimada; los detalles se acuerdan con cada prestador.
entries.cta: Cuéntanos qué necesitas trasladar y en qué comuna buscas.
entries.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one complete finished professional Spanish advertisement for ConectaProIA, portrait 4:5, premium editorial design, readable bold typography with precise accents. New brand ad about planning a move. Warm ivory background, deep navy and confident burnt-orange accents, generous margins 8%, organized hierarchy, ONE friendly photographic scene at right showing moving boxes, a simple house key and unbranded moving van, no readable plates. No testimonial, no badges, no invented claims, no prices. All text must be crisp, real words, fully inside margins, large enough for a phone. Include EXACT text, with appropriate hierarchy: brand 'ConectaProIA'; main headline '¿Te cambias de casa?'; subheadline 'Antes de cargar las cajas, encuentra a quién contactar.'; small practical line 'Fletes y mudanzas según tu comuna.'; prominent CTA 'Cuéntanos origen, destino y fecha.'; prominent contact block 'WhatsApp +56 9 8343 4503'; website 'conectaproia.cl'; clear benefit 'Buscar contactos es gratis.'; bottom clarification 'El traslado lo cobra cada prestador. Consulta disponibilidad y valores.' Do not add any other words. Do not say verified, instant, guaranteed or free moving. Avoid tiny legal print. No text over faces. No UI screenshot, no collage of advertisements. A professional polished campaign poster that feels distinct from generic service-template ads.

entries.title: Tu próximo contacto para el auto
entries.intro: ¿Tu auto necesita una revisión? ConectaProIA te ayuda a buscar contactos de mecánica automotriz. Describe lo que necesitas e indica tu comuna para empezar la búsqueda. El diagnóstico y el trabajo se acuerdan directamente con el taller o profesional.
entries.cta: Escríbenos qué necesita tu auto y en qué comuna buscas un taller.
entries.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE complete finished premium professional Spanish advertising poster for ConectaProIA, vertical 4:5. Distinctive refined automotive editorial direction, deep blue-black/navy, bright lime and ivory typography, generous 8% safe margins, clear bold humanist sans serif, restrained graphic speed lines but not racing. Main visual lower middle: photorealistic clean generic automotive workshop, professional in neutral navy work clothes beside a car with diagnostic tablet, closed hood or orderly inspection, no readable screen or plate, no vehicle logo, no emergency, no dramatic damage, not a testimonial. Crisp legible type, entire artwork inside canvas. Do not add text. Professional brand campaign, not a screenshot or busy flyer.
